mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paper_portfolio_position ( account_no, stock_code, stock_name, quantity, available_quantity, average_buy_price, current_price, purchase_amount, valuation_amount, profit_loss_amount, profit_loss_rate, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{accountNo}, #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{quantity}, #{availableQuantity}, #{averageBuyPrice}, #{currentPrice}, #{purchaseAmount}, #{valuationAmount}, #{profitLossAmount}, #{profitLossRate}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_name = VALUES(stock_name), quantity = VALUES(quantity), available_quantity = VALUES(available_quantity), average_buy_price = VALUES(average_buy_price), current_price = VALUES(current_price), purchase_amount = VALUES(purchase_amount), valuation_amount = VALUES(valuation_amount), profit_loss_amount = VALUES(profit_loss_amount), profit_loss_rate = VALUES(profit_loss_rate), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_no, stock_code, stock_name, quantity, available_quantity, average_buy_price, current_price, purchase_amount, valuation_amount, profit_loss_amount, profit_loss_rate, created_at, updated_at FROM paper_portfolio_position WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} ORDER BY valuation_amount DESC

SELECT id, account_no, stock_code, stock_name, quantity, available_quantity, average_buy_price, current_price, purchase_amount, valuation_amount, profit_loss_amount, profit_loss_rate, created_at, updated_at FROM paper_portfolio_position WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND quantity > 0 ORDER BY valuation_amount DESC

SELECT id, account_no, stock_code, stock_name, quantity, available_quantity, average_buy_price, current_price, purchase_amount, valuation_amount, profit_loss_amount, profit_loss_rate, created_at, updated_at FROM paper_portfolio_position WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND stock_code = #{stockCode} LIMIT 1
